text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the last day of summer camp, and I'm
doing
my daily email check when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see that I've received an email with the
subject
line, "URA Official
Merchandising Approved."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan takes the laptop I was
showing her
to get a closer look.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"In consideration of your success in the
Oka Sho,
the Sprinters Stakes, and
various other races, we
would be
delighted to work with you in

merchandising..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"And in particular, to help realize your
ambition
of becoming a mascot."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how suddenly this is
happening.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The bus is about to leave... but I can't sit
still right
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't just let her run all the way back...
But
there's no way I'll be able to keep
up with her if I
give chase, either...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yay! I did it! I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I finally manage to catch up with
Aston
Machan, she's jumping for joy at
the top of a hill.
